Lemma
[Unbounded conformal factor concentrates curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0123, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0124 ↗ lem:chow-iv-positive-circular-average-bound 1. ch29:29.33\group Backward Pressure Limit

If $\overline u(z_0,t_i)\to \infty $, then every fixed Euclidean ball about $z_0$ contains asymptotically at least $4\pi $ of total scalar curvature.
